rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation on supported completed returns; f1040s3 (2025) p.1 line2 carries Form2441 line11. The project short-circuits when the care-expense screen is No, for which qualifying care amounts and the credit are zero. With care Yes both use line11. MFS is outside completed-return scope at s3.line11. The guard also avoids evaluating an unused form and its unanswered screens; partial-input execution is deliberately not asserted equivalent.

Ruling: representation on completed consistent returns; f1040s3 (2025) p.1 line5a carries Form5695 line15. f5695.part1_any asks whether there are eligible PartI costs or a carry-in; with neither the PartI credit is zero, and with Yes the two trees use the same line15. The project exit avoids questions on an unfiled PartI. This is a form-application distinction, not identity on inconsistent amounts or unanswered irrelevant screens.

Ruling: representation on completed consistent returns; f1040s3 (2025) p.1 line5b carries Form5695 line32. With no PartII improvement or audit expenses its credit is zero; with the part active both use the same line32. The project early exit avoids evaluating an unused part. No identity is claimed for inconsistent screen/amount answers or partial-input order.
